title: Resolution urging Albany to legalize plug-in balcony solar panels
summary: This resolution calls on the Governor to sign the SUNNY Act (S.8512-C/A.9111-C), which would exempt small plug-in solar devices up to 1,200 watts from standard utility interconnection and net metering rules. The bill would let renters and homeowners more easily use balcony or window solar panels to offset electricity costs. It also requires such devices to be certified by a nationally recognized testing laboratory.
